'''Florando''' (Japanese: '''ラフォールタウン''' ''Lafall Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town in [[Johto]] that appeared in ''[[Flower Power]]''. It is located in between [[New Bark Town]] and [[Cherrygrove City]].

Every year, there is the [[Pokémon Exhibition]], a gigantic outdoor Pokémon entertainment festival where [[Pokémon Trainer]]s and {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} come from around the world to put on shows and perform. While they passed through Florando, {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} met [[Bailey]], one of the performers in the Exhibition. They helped one of her {{p|Bellossom}} overcome its lack of confidence in its {{pkmn|Contest}}-like performance.
